title: route51-fleet-planning: Fleet Planning Console and Route 51 pipeline
description:
Fleet Planning Console and the five-layer Route 51 pipeline (synthetic data generation, privacy aggregation, data fusion, NSGA-II headway optimisation, SUMO microsimulation and economic evaluation) accompanying the master's thesis An AI System Architecture for Urban Bus Service Optimisation Based on Aggregated Telecom and ATTO Fare-Payment Data: Design and Simulation-Based Evaluation on a Tashkent Corridor (IT Park University, 2026).

Results release route51_v2_20260922. All passenger, fare-payment and telecom data are synthetic; no operational data are included.
